title: LOGINventory script manifest (LI-MANIFEST), schema version 1
description: Describes a script of the script-based inventory. The JSON is embedded at the top of the script as the first <# LI-MANIFEST ... #> comment block. LOGINventory reads it to show title, description and parameters; the script itself runs unchanged.

id.description: Stable identifier of the script. Never changes, even if the title changes.

version.description: Script version (SemVer). Raise it with every change of the script.

tier.description: Trust tier: login = developed and supported by LOGIN, partner = together with a partner who is responsible for the content, community = contributed by users, checked by LOGIN for malicious code only.

partner.description: Required for tier 'partner': the partner who is responsible for the content.

title.description: Short name shown in the catalog.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what the script reads and what it creates in LOGINventory.

creates.description: What the script creates in LOGINventory.

engine.description: pwsh = PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe, default), psc = LOGINventory PowerShell (psc.exe, Windows PowerShell 5, shipped with the product). Set as parameter 'engine' of the definition.

minLiVersion.description: Lowest LOGINventory 9 version the script runs with. Omit if there is no known restriction.

files.description: Sub folders with additional files that belong to the script and are installed with it, e.g. "CyberInsight/".

modules.description: PowerShell modules that must be installed for the chosen engine. Empty if none.

permissions.description: Permissions or credentials to prepare on the vendor side, shown as a checklist.

endpoints.description: Hosts the script talks to, for firewall and proxy rules. Informational only.

testRun.description: true if the script can run without side effects (only reads data and writes .inv files).

docs.description: Link to the instructions for this script.

parameters.description: Every parameter the script reads via $ctx.UserParameters, and nothing else.

presets.description: Optional ready-made definitions, e.g. one per action of the script.

name.description: Key as the script reads it from $ctx.UserParameters (case-insensitive).

type.description: secret = stored encrypted as password entity; path = file or folder on the computer running the Remote Scanner service.

parameters.description: Parameter values of the preset, keys must be declared parameters.
